verdict.rationale: The only evidence of getting data off the device is a community report that the Nitrokey HSM lets you escrow key material offline as an AES-encrypted paper backup (DKEK). Another hands-on report says attestation certs cannot be exported via PKCS#11 and are stored in a non-standard ASN.1 container, which weakens the 'open formats' part of the story. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a full data export (keys, OTP secrets, password-manager entries), confirmation that exports use open formats, and a documented migration or exit path for Nitrokey 3 devices.
